quotes.text: Brilliant experience today started with a nice warm welcome from the women (think it was Michelle) at the desk and took good care of us with free coffee and drinks in a nice waiting room. Tobias was an excellent pilot and knew his job very well and was very experienced. He showed us all the landmarks around New York and at the end offered to take photos and answer any questions about the helicopter which was a nice touch. Amazing day out and definitely worth it.

Amazing experience, from the beginning of walking through the front door, to the helicopter ride and exiting!!The staff was very kind and helpful and our pilot was amazingly nice . The view was beautiful, I got some amazing photos and videos. I definitely recommend this place, it's an unforgettable experience. They also offer red bulls and Fiji water bottles and sodas ,coffee free of charge! Thank you guys for making this experience amazing!!!

From start to finish, this experience was flawless. Customer service was on point - the front desk, the driver, and our pilot were all professional & seemed to genuinely enjoy their jobs and interacting with the guests. Our pilot - Rad(?) - was surly & sarcastic, but made us feel safe. We were able to see all of Manhattan up close from all sides of the helicopter. A memorable flight for sure.

Really amazing! Worth every penny spent on this. I got to sit with the pilot. You should arrive at-least 40 minutes early. Made me feel really safe in the flight as well. They seem to really care about the customers, everyone was so nice to me! I highly recommend this without paying tickets to several landmarks you can see everything at once!!

Amazing! It was worth every penny. Staff were exceptionally friendly. I was copilot to Devon (I believe?) who was great. The views were amazing and the flight was super smooth. Waiting area and transport are clean and comfortable as well. This is already the highlight of our trip. 10/10 would recommend this to anybody.

Our flight experience was absolutely fantastic! The pilot was skilled and made the journey smooth and enjoyable. A special shoutout to Luis at reception—he went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. Truly outstanding service from start to finish!
